text: Dre. Why is there a birthday card going around with my name on it?
Oh, that's for Miss Linda. Her birthday's today. Everybody chipped in.
Chipped in what?
Twenty dollars. I'm collecting.
You're collecting money.
I'm the gift guy now.
Dre, you still owe ME forty dollars.
That's personal business. This is office business.
How much did you collect?
Two hundred and forty dollars. Twelve people.
Okay. So what did we get her?
A card.
A card. And what else?
The card is real nice, Skip. It sings.
Two hundred and forty dollars, and she gets a card that sings?
It sings Happy Birthday AND it got glitter.
Where's the rest of the money?
Processing fees.
Processing fees?! What are you, a bank?
Gas to the store. My time. Snacks for the drive.
You drove to the gas station across the street!
Traffic was crazy.
Let me see the card. Happy birthday, Linda. From Dre.
There wasn't room for all twelve names.
It's just your name! The whole card! Big letters!
I signed it on behalf of the team. That's leadership.
Miss Linda is gonna think you bought her a two hundred dollar card!
And she gave me a hug, too.
She hugged YOU?
Yeah. And she said I'm getting a raise.
Give me my twenty dollars back.
Bet. I got you Friday.
Which Friday, Dre?
A Friday. They come every week.
